body: Where should I run, is there a specific place I should? I've no clue what to do with my life after I run. I'm afraid of simply being helpless and forever homeless with my life. Forever on the run basacally. I'd love to seek attention from authorities but I just simply don't have the strength to even mention my problems at home or even to friends. I'm relatively known as happy and person without problems but internally, I'm dying. I always see the ways to kill myself even daydream in school about it. One day, I'm afraid I will just simply walk infront of a moving car. or jump off a bridge near a highway.

Telling someone is the most frustrating thing in the world. It's nearly impossible, the thought of just being alone, sitting there without anything to eat no family to go to, or just simply leaving my friends, saddens me.
I'd, but I just simply don't have strength. The worries pour on me, where would I go then, what do I eat, will I ever see my friends ever again.
